name: Our Love is Electrifying
source:
You're lonely, sad, and trying out online dating. Your likes are almost always empty aside from people just trying to hookup. You keep getting ghosted everytime you think you're finally getting to know someone. Everyday on your own drains more and more hope from you. Your phone dings with a notification from your dating app. It reminds you to check your new likes, however it is empty as usual. "Am I really that unlovable?" The question made your heart ache painfully...
